title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 12: why the wicked prosper, running with footmen and horses, a destroyed vineyard, and compassion after plucking up.

questions.text: What question does the speaker put to Yahweh at the start of this chapter?
questions.explanation: He calls Yahweh righteous but wants to reason the cause with Him, asking, "Why does the way of the wicked prosper?"

answers.text: "Why have you forgotten your covenant?"
"How long will the enemy mock?"
"Where are the former mercies?"
"Why does the way of the wicked prosper?"

questions.text: Where is Yahweh in relation to the wicked, according to the speaker?
questions.explanation: The speaker says of the wicked that Yahweh is near in their mouth, and far from their heart.

answers.text: Hidden from the eyes of all of them
Near in their mouth, and far from their heart
Absent from their houses and their fields
Written on the foreheads of their children

questions.text: If running with the footmen has wearied you, with what does Yahweh ask how you can contend?
questions.explanation: Yahweh asks, "If you have run with the footmen, and they have wearied you, then how can you contend with horses?"

answers.text: With horses
With chariots
With giants
With kings

questions.text: What is the speaker told about his brothers and the house of his father?
questions.explanation: Even his brothers and the house of his father have dealt treacherously with him, so he must not believe them, though they speak beautiful words to him.

answers.text: They will defend him against his enemies
They have fled to Egypt
They have dealt treacherously with him
They have sold his inheritance

questions.text: What has Yahweh's heritage become to Him, so that He has hated her?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "My heritage has become to me as a lion in the forest. She has uttered her voice against me. Therefore I have hated her."

answers.text: As a wild donkey in the desert
As a lion in the forest
As a wolf among the sheep
As a serpent by the path

questions.text: Who have destroyed Yahweh's vineyard and trodden His portion under foot?
questions.explanation: Many shepherds have destroyed His vineyard, trodden His portion under foot, and made His pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.

answers.text: Many shepherds
The kings of the north
The wild boars of the forest
The armies of Egypt

questions.text: What have they reaped after sowing wheat?
questions.explanation: The text says, "They have sown wheat, and have reaped thorns. They have exhausted themselves, and profit nothing."

answers.text: Barley
Chaff
Nothing at all
Thorns

questions.text: What does Yahweh say He will do to His evil neighbors who touch the inheritance of His people?
questions.explanation: Concerning all His evil neighbors who touch the inheritance of Israel, Yahweh says He will pluck them up from off their land.

answers.text: Make a covenant with them
Send famine on their cities
Pluck them up from off their land
Give them to the king of Judah

questions.text: What will Yahweh do after He has plucked them up?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says that after He has plucked them up, He will return and have compassion on them, and bring them again, every man to his heritage and his land.

answers.text: Return and have compassion on them
Scatter them among all nations forever
Burn their cities with fire
Give their land to Israel

questions.text: On what condition will the neighboring nations be built up in the middle of Yahweh's people?
questions.explanation: If they diligently learn the ways of His people, to swear by His name, "As Yahweh lives," then they will be built up in the middle of His people.

answers.text: If they pay tribute to Jerusalem
If they tear down their high places
If they send their sons to the temple
If they learn to swear by Yahweh's name
